prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene of a two-vehicle collision on the access road in Katy, Texas, I observed a sideswipe collision between two passenger vehicles. Driver 1 stated that they were changing lanes to the left when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 entered their lane from the adjacent lane, making contact with the rear driver-side quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they had checked the mirror but did not see Driver 1's vehicle until contact occurred. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was also present and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee and was evaluated at the scene by EMS, then declined transport at that time. Both vehicles sustained visible body damage and were drivable. No citations were issued pending further investigation. Witness information was not obtained at the scene.
